title: Decision 4: the Deza shop codes, the shops they map to, and the store discovery
keys: A shop code is keyed by its chain, its code and its printed name. A shop is keyed by its chain, its address, its postal code and its OpenStreetMap reference.
decidedBy: The owner, 2026-10-06 (decision 4), and two later answers of the same day: the shops of C1, Z1 and C2, and the store discovery for T2 and T7.
note: A mapping publishes the stored claims of the shop in the same request. shopRowsWritten is the count of supermarket_location_items of the shop after it.

entries.ownerDecision: Decided by the owner, 2026-10-06: the ten shop codes are mapped by their street names to the Deza shops of the catalog. CONSULTAR is ignored and never mapped.
entries.ownerAnswerAfterTheRegister: Decided by the owner, 2026-10-06, after the register was written: C1 is the shop at Imprenta de la Alborada 116, Z1 the shop at José María Martorell, and C2 the shop at Libertador Sucre 38.
entries.why: No address holds the printed name. The owner named the shop.
